manifesto: I'm a software engineer who builds enterprise web products — the interface, the API, the data model underneath, and the AI features on top. You get one person who can take a feature from a rough idea to something running in production.

Over five years I've moved from frontend work on enterprise Angular apps to full-stack and AI-powered delivery at Bridginex: 16+ production projects, 100+ REST APIs, and AI-driven recruitment, matching, and automation tools built with Angular, React, Next.js, Node, and the OpenAI API.

I build with AI in the loop — using Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, and MCP to move from requirements to shipped features faster, without dropping quality. Based in Surat and available for contract and freelance work, anywhere remote.
